title: 'American Scoundrel' traces Roy Cohn's playbook from McCarthyism to Trump
content: NPR Author Interviews LISTEN & FOLLOW NPR App Apple Podcasts Spotify Amazon Music iHeart Radio RSS link Author Interviews 'American Scoundrel' traces Roy Cohn's playbook from McCarthyism to Trump September 17, 2026 12:14 PM ET Heard on Fresh Air Terry Gross 'American Scoundrel' traces Roy Cohn's playbook from McCarthyism to Trump Audio will be available later today. In Kai Bird's biography of Cohn, he looks at how the lawyer taught Trump how to deny, delay, attack, sue and countersue, never admit defeat, side-step paying bills and avoid a paper trail.
